title: PARALLAX
alt_text: A dark stone chamber. A tall stone post hides the far wall's only opening. The camera steps to the side and a narrow stairway passage appears behind it, then moves slowly toward it.

location.name: Petra
location.why: A sheer rock wall, and a narrow opening in it (the Siq) that leads to the Treasury. The wall is real; so is the way through.

youtube.title: 025 | PARALLAX 👁️ #philosophy #motivation
youtube.description:
Never negative. Never make-believe.

The wall is real.
So is the opening you haven't noticed.

You don't have to change the facts to change where you look.

Do not invent the good.
Do not miss it either.

—

linkedin.post:
Never negative. Never make-believe.

The wall is real: the setback, the deadline, the number on the report. So is the opening you haven't noticed yet.

Clear thinking doesn't change the facts. It changes where you stand when you look at them.

Do not invent the good. Do not miss it either.
